content: OWASP File Upload guidance recommends allowlisted needed formats, server-generated filenames, layered content checks, constrained processing, private storage and authentication/authorization. Client MIME is untrusted. Lafu inference: payment screenshots require owner/admin access checks, upload limits and safe previews; do not count a local file selection or unfinished storage upload as submitted proof. https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/File_Upload_Cheat_Sheet.html
